induced_path_lift: For each dynamic vertex retain the same vertex.
For each quotient node [C] choose one arbitrary z_C in C.
Inside U all adjacencies and nonadjacencies are copied exactly.
A cross edge u-[C] gives u complete to C.
A cross nonedge plus source axiom (iv) on connected C gives u anticomplete to C.
Distinct Y0 components have no intercomponent edges.
replay.no_sigma_dependency: No step references L(u), old type, witness mask, support profile, or coarse signature.
coupling: If residual component C had no outside neighbor in G\X0, then connectedness of G\X0 would fail because C is anticomplete to S.
Any outside neighbor is dynamic and becomes complete to C by axiom (iv).

limitations: No list-coloring tractability follows from P7-free Q_ALL.
No selector compilation is included here.
